competences.description: Attacks the enemy to decrease Defense for 2 turns with a 40% chance. This attack will deal more damage according to your Defense.

effets.description: The target's Defense will be decreased by 70%.

competences.description: Defends the ally with the lowest HP for 3 turns, then charges fearlessly towards the enemy target with the Hollyberry Shield. Deals damage that increases according to your Defense on the attacked target and stuns for 1 turn.

effets.description: The caster of this skill will receive half of the damage inflicted on the escorted target while making the damage dealt to the defended target to 0 and counterattack the enemy target.
The target will be stunned and won't be able to attack.

competences.description: Increases the Defense of all allies for 2 turns and decreases the damage that they receive by 200% of your Defense until your next turn. During this time, you gain immunity against inability effects and your Attack Speed is set to 100, unaffected by any effects that change it.

effets.description: Decreases damage received by a certain amount
The target's Attack Speed will be decreased by 30%.
The target's defense will be increased by 70%.
